title: Authority Facet
description: SDD-R011 §15, SDD-R012 §5/§12. Identifies where the engineering truth this object records originates -- independent of ownership (which organization maintains the authoring) and of provenance (which records the authoring/review process). SDD-R012 §7 describes authoritative references eventually becoming their own Source Object EKOs (e.g. standard.iec.60617); until those exist, `authority_reference` is a free-text description -- see docs/SCHEMA_MIGRATION.md for the deferred normalization.

authority_reference.description: Free text identifying the specific law/standard/specification (e.g. "Ohm's Law", "IEC 60617") until a corresponding Source Object EKO exists to reference by Object ID.

authority_source_object.description: Object ID of a Source Object EKO (SDD-R012 §7, e.g. standard.iec.60617), once one is authored. Null for this work package -- no Source Object EKOs exist yet, and creating them is out of scope (see docs/SCHEMA_MIGRATION.md).
